extracted.name: Yogurt sauce
extracted.description: Combine Greek yogurt with mango chutney and ground cumin to make this fruity, spicy yogurt. Enjoy with our onion bhaji chicken tenders or in sandwiches
instruction_lines: Combine the Greek yogurt, mango chutney and ground cumin in a small bowl, then season to taste. Try serving with our onion bhaji chicken tenders and crunchy slaw, if you like.
